titulo_fr: Un récit à remettre en ordre : Observer les formes
titulo_es: A story to be ordered: Vocabulary and forms
intro: It restruates the sequence of a story and distinguishes cause, discovery and result. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It restruates the sequence of a story and distinguishes cause, discovery and result. It separates the fact of its context: the verbal times, connectors and powers indicate when and who provides each data.
Attention point: « Dès que », « pendant que » and « finalement » express temporal relationships; relative pronouns retake earlier elements. In this fragment, «pendant» means «during».

frases.fr: Nous sommes entrés dans une vieille librairie qui se trouvait au coin de la rue.
frases.es: Entramos en una librería antigua que estaba en la esquina.
frases.en: We went into an old bookstore that was on the corner.

frases.fr: Pendant que nous attendions, la libraire a reconnu le sac que j'avais perdu la veille.
frases.es: Mientras esperábamos, la librera reconoció el bolso que yo había perdido el día anterior.
frases.en: While we were waiting, the bookcase recognized the bag I had lost the day before.
